QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Jake, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to greet #b#p417##k, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p417#, a resident of #m10003000#. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

0.0: "There isn't a whole lot you're forced to do as a resident of #m10003000#, but hey, if you're up for it, I'd highly recommend chatting with the locals around here. Come to think of it, it would be a good idea to go say hi to #p417# as well.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: If you plan on using the subway, you can head right in this way. Oh? That's not why you're here, but rather because you've become a new resident of this city? Haha, well how about that! A brand-new resident of #m10003000#.
1.1: My name is #p417#. I guide the people coming and going through the subway here. It's a job assigned to me by the city, so I'm doing my best, but... honestly, the inside is completely crawling with monsters, so I'm never quite sure if guiding folks in there is actually the right thing to do. Haha.
1.2: Since we've become neighbors, it's a pleasure to meet you, and I look forward to seeing you around. And if you are thinking of heading inside, you'd better make sure you're well-prepared. Haha!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
